    "file": "src/utils/tags.js",
    "line": 111,
    "summary": "A post is listed as related to itself. getAllPosts() includes the input post, which shares every one of its own tags, and nothing filters it out. Once the sort is fixed it will always rank first. Fix: add `.filter((other) => other.slug !== post.slug)` before scoring. Compare by slug, not by reference, because callers like Note.jsx may pass the usePost object rather than the index entry.",
    "failure_scenario": "On the Note page for slug 'foo' with tags [ai], relatedPosts(meta) includes 'foo' itself, so the 'Related posts' list links back to the page the reader is already on and shows only limit-1 real suggestions.",

comments.body:
<!-- claude-code-ship-local reviewed=504ffdf1386f876ab1a29bbbaa2a7c6b9145ea3f -->
Claude Code reviewed this change at 452326d for the author: 5 findings, 3 fixed.

- `src/utils/tags.js:117` sorted ascending, so the limit kept the weakest matches instead of the best ones. Fixed in 504ffdf.
- `src/utils/tags.js:111` the input post was scored against itself and could appear in its own related list. Fixed in 504ffdf (filtered out by slug).
- `src/utils/tags.js:110` an unused variable failed the lint step of the check. Fixed in 504ffdf.
- `src/utils/tags.js:118` posts with equal shared counts keep content-index order (newest first, since the sort is stable). Left: acceptable default; weighting by tag rarity would be a design choice.
- `src/utils/tags.js:108` nothing calls the helper yet, so no page shows related posts. Left: the change is titled as adding the helper only.
